segments.NAM.1.2-3: The LORD punishes his enemies but is slow to anger
segments.NAM.1.4-5: The LORD’s power shakes the sea, mountains and earth
segments.NAM.1.6-6: No one can stand before the LORD’s burning anger
segments.NAM.1.7-8: The LORD protects those who trust him and ends Nineveh
segments.NAM.1.9-11: The LORD will end the evil plots of Nineveh
segments.NAM.1.12-13: The LORD promises to free Judah from Nineveh’s yoke
segments.NAM.1.14-14: The LORD commands that Nineveh will have no descendants
segments.NAM.1.15-15: Good news for Judah: the wicked will be cut off
segments.NAM.2.1-2: An enemy attacks Nineveh and the LORD restores Jacob
segments.NAM.2.3-4: Red-clad warriors and chariots rush through the city
segments.NAM.2.5-5: The attackers rush to Nineveh’s wall
segments.NAM.2.6-7: The river gates open and Nineveh’s palace falls
segments.NAM.2.8-10: Nineveh is emptied, plundered and laid waste
segments.NAM.2.13-13: The LORD declares that he is against Nineveh
segments.NAM.3.1-2: Woe to Nineveh, the city of blood and lies
segments.NAM.3.3-4: Nineveh’s war and witchcraft leave many dead
segments.NAM.3.5-7: The LORD will shame Nineveh before the nations
segments.NAM.3.10-11: Thebes went into exile, and Nineveh will also fall
segments.NAM.3.12-13: Nineveh’s fortresses and troops will fall to enemies
segments.NAM.3.14-15: Nineveh’s defenses will not save it from fire and sword
segments.NAM.3.16-17: Nineveh’s merchants and guards will vanish like locusts
segments.NAM.3.18-19: Assyria’s king falls, and all who hear applaud
